decision.question: the floating mic (.ux-dictate-ptt-mic) never appears in the DOM on a real page load, headless, on either / or /framework/ux/Hotkeys/ -- why, and is it mine to fix?
options: patch push-to-talk.js to explicitly append_to(View.body()) like devbar.js/devshell.js do
report the root cause and let the mastermind route a fix (push-to-talk.js is a sibling task's file, not in this proof task's fence)
decision.chose: report the root cause and let the mastermind route a fix
decision.why: Traced it live: View.captor is null when push_to_talk(app) runs inside App.render() (it is set to app.$pages only on the LINE AFTER push_to_talk(this) runs) -- so the plain div.c(...) calls building $mic/$hidden silently auto-append to nothing (View.js's own append guard: `this.capture && View.captor && View.captor.append(this)`), no throw, no console error. devbar.js and devshell.js avoid this exact trap by deferring: `app.styles_loaded().then(() => $bar.append_to(View.body()))`. push-to-talk.js's own class doc claims the same 'beside .app' shape but never does the deferred append. Confirmed with node debug scripts against the live push-to-talk.localhost server (not guessed). My brief's fence is the proof script + proof.md only -- push-to-talk.js belongs to the sibling task that built it, so the fix is one line for whoever owns that file, not mine to make here.

decision.question: cross-mount double-send (ask from @task-mastermind-one-dictation): does push-to-talk's hidden chat() mount plus a page's own visible chat() mount cause more than one Session.say() POST per utterance?
options: drive it live headless (build two chat() mounts, call panel.submit() on both with the same text, count POST /api/session/say)
answer from reading chat.js's own deliver()/own_ats/seen_chat code, since the worktree server is down
decision.chose: answer from reading the code; the live run is still owed
decision.why: Attempted the live run three times over about 30s after this worktree's own dev server (push-to-talk.localhost) started returning 502 mid-task -- Servex restarted mid-turn, unrelated to anything this task touched, and the worktree server did not come back up in that window. Restarting a dev server is never a minion's call (minion skill's own Never list), so I answered from the code instead of waiting longer on a $1 budget: chat.js's deliver() callback (~218) calls Session.say() independently per mount; own_ats/seen_chat are declared fresh INSIDE each chat() call (one set per mount, never shared) and only dedupe the RECEIVING side (watch()+stream() both reporting the same already-sent line back to the mount that sent it) -- nothing dedupes two SEPARATE mounts each calling Session.say() with the same text. Confirmed: more than 1 send per utterance is the real behavior, not exactly 1. This is a chat.js design-level risk (any two live keep:true mounts), not push-to-talk-specific -- push-to-talk's hidden mount is just a second ordinary mount, same mechanism as any other second chat()/Widget() call.
